headline: Ibstock Issues Profits Warning as Third-Quarter Sales Fall Below Expectations
summary: UK brickmaker Ibstock issued a profits warning after reporting third-quarter sales that were 22% below expectations.
why: Profit warnings from major building material suppliers signal weakness in domestic construction and housing sectors, impacting broader economic forecasts.

impacts.name: Ibstock
impacts.why: A profits warning directly lowers investor expectations and share value.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Lower-than-expected sales and a formal profits warning directly cause downward revisions in company valuation.
